pages.title: Asks Only for Daylight
pages.text: Quetzera's Faith Altar wants nothing fed to it and nothing killed near it - it simply reads its own light level, sun or torchlight alike, and earns Faith from however bright the sky above it happens to be.

pages.title: Warmed, and Left Cold
pages.text: Pledged to him, daylight brings Night Vision, a faint glow, quickened hands and feet, and armor that thickens the longer you've kept faith. Night takes all of it back and adds its own toll - slowness, hunger, and weakness settle in the moment the sun goes down, same as any snake losing its warmth after dark.
